description: Queue AI assessments for multiple evidence files (write — editor+ role, async, max 50). Provide evidence_id, file_ids, and/or assess_unassessed. Returns count queued.

assess_unassessed.description: Also assess every file that has no existing assessment (default false)

evidence_id.description: Evidence ID — assesses every file under this evidence item

file_ids.description: Specific evidence file UUIDs to assess

name: scf_bulk_assess_evidence
